sentences.text:
Mr. Arijeet Mishra, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party
 Mr. Manoj Kumar Mohanty, Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
 Order
Order No. 19.10.2023
01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
3. The Petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Tomaka P.S. Case No.113 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.1230 of 2023 arising out of I.C.C. Case No.380 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Jajpur Road for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 406/420/120-B and 34 of IPC.
4.

Considering the fact and the nature of accusations and also the materials on record, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioners to surrender before the Court below within a week from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
